title: Email
help: Elysium reads and sends mail from these mailboxes. Credentials are encrypted and never shown, and Gmail and Outlook passwords never reach Elysium at all. Self-hosted mailboxes live on one mail server, which can host any number of domains.

empty.title: No mail server yet
empty.description: Create one to host your own domains and mailboxes.

server.loadError: The mail server could not be loaded.

failed.title: The mail server could not be created

unreachable.title: The mail server is not answering
unreachable.description: Domains and self-hosted mailboxes can change again once it answers. {{error}}

serverForm.title: Create mail server
serverForm.description: The mail server runs on this host. Elysium is its administrator and keeps the administrator password encrypted.
serverForm.domainHint: Addresses end in it, such as agent@example.com.
serverForm.hostnameHint: The name every domain's MX record points to.
serverForm.exists: The mail server is already set up.

errors.domainInvalid: Enter a domain such as example.com.
errors.hostnameInvalid: Enter a hostname such as mail.example.com.

domains.defaultHint: The domain the server was created with, kept as long as the server is.

domainForm.title: Add domain
domainForm.description: The domain shares the mail server and its hostname with every other domain.
domainForm.name: Domain

errors.nameInvalid: Enter a domain such as example.org.

removeDomain.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeDomain.description: The mail server stops hosting {{name}} and deletes its DKIM signing keys.
removeDomain.hasMailboxes_one: Delete the {{count, compact}} mailbox on {{name}} first.
removeDomain.hasMailboxes_other: Delete the {{count, compact}} mailboxes on {{name}} first.

dns.title: DNS records for {{name}}
dns.description: Publish these at your DNS provider for this domain to send and receive mail on the internet.
dns.loadError: The records could not be loaded.
dns.dkimPending: DKIM keys are generated a few seconds after a domain is added. Check again shortly.
dns.zoneFileHint: Includes optional service discovery records, as a zone file.

internet.title: Receiving mail from the internet
internet.description: Point an address record for {{hostname}} at this host, and let mail in on ports 25, 465, and 993. Reverse DNS and a TLS certificate for {{hostname}} are up to you.

availability.brokerMissing: Gmail and Outlook sign-in is not set up on this server yet. Whoever runs Elysium can turn it on.

brokerUnreachable.title: Gmail and Outlook sign-in is not answering
brokerUnreachable.description: Gmail and Outlook can connect again once it answers. {{error}}

availability.providerMissing: {{provider}} sign-in is not set up on this server yet. Whoever runs Elysium can add it.
availability.mailDomainMissing: Add a domain to the mail server first.

table.label: Mailboxes
table.empty: No mailboxes yet. Connect an account or create a mailbox to get started.

createForm.title: Create mailbox
createForm.description: A mailbox on Elysium's own mail server. Mail stays on this host: reaching the internet needs a real domain and DNS first.
createForm.domainHint: Add more domains on the Domains tab.

errors.localPartRequired: Enter a name for the address.
errors.localPartInvalid: Use letters, digits, and . _ + - only, without a leading, trailing, or doubled dot.
errors.addressTaken: A mailbox with this address already exists.

mailboxForm.title: Edit {{address}}
mailboxForm.notFound: This mailbox does not exist, or was removed.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {{address}}?
disconnect.selfHosted: {{address}} is deleted from Elysium's mail server, along with every message in it. The address becomes available again.
disconnect.oauth: Elysium forgets {{address}} and its credential. The mailbox itself is untouched, and you can also revoke Elysium's access from your {{provider}} account settings.

toasts.testPassed: {{address}} signed in to IMAP and SMTP
toasts.sendFailed: The test message could not be sent
toasts.connectFailed: The account could not be connected
toasts.serverCreateFailed: The mail server could not be created

oauthErrors.access_denied: Access was not granted. Connect again and approve it.
oauthErrors.state_mismatch: The connection was started in another browser. Start it again from this page.
oauthErrors.flow_expired: The connection took longer than fifteen minutes or was already completed. Start it again.
oauthErrors.broker_unavailable: Gmail and Outlook sign-in is no longer set up on this server.
oauthErrors.broker_refused: The sign-in did not hand over the account. Connect again.
oauthErrors.no_refresh_token: The provider did not grant lasting access. Try again and approve every permission.
oauthErrors.no_address: The provider did not share the account's email address.
oauthErrors.provider_unavailable: Sign-in for this provider is not set up on this server.
oauthErrors.provider_error: The provider reported an error. Connect again.
oauthErrors.address_in_use: That address is already connected as a different kind of mailbox.
oauthErrors.internal_error: Elysium could not save the account.
